## [1.3.0](https://github.com/bin0culars/bin0culars-patches/compare/v1.2.1...v1.3.0) (2026-11-09)

### ✨ New Features

* **reddit:** choose how much the side panel dims the feed ([#16](https://github.com/bin0culars/bin0culars-patches/issues/16)) ([1d06bf3](https://github.com/bin0culars/bin0culars-patches/commit/1d06bf313eba8ac3dd44ba1c8f6fd909eda8d997))

patches.name: Account switcher private mode
patches.description: Lets you choose whether the account switcher offers Anonymous Browsing or Incognito, even with one account. Choose in Settings → bin0culars mods.

patches.name: Post side panel
patches.description: On tablets in landscape, opens posts in a panel on the right while the feed stays visible. Can be turned off in Settings → bin0culars mods.

patches.name: Tablet grid feed
patches.description: Shows the feed as a grid with 2 or 3 columns on tablets and other wide screens. Phones are unchanged.
